title: How We Compare Major Exchanges: Fees, Liquidity and KYC Flow
summary: A plain-language framework for comparing venues — maker/taker fees, withdrawal costs, liquidity depth and onboarding friction.

body.p: Most 'best exchange' lists are affiliate copy. We keep it boring: a fixed set of criteria, applied the same way to every venue we review.

body.h: The four things we look at first

list: **Maker/taker fees** — the headline number hides volume tiers and token-burn discounts.
**Liquidity depth** — tighter books mean less slippage for market orders.
**Withdrawal costs & limits** — the fee you forget until it's too late.
**KYC/onboarding** — how many steps before your first trade, and what's asked.

body.p: When a review mentions a specific venue, the page is clearly labelled as a partner or sponsored slot. Editorial content stays independent of any referral relationship.
